title: Democracy and justice: courts, rights and trust
goal: Read how courts and rights worked in the new democracies, using a pesar de and pese a.
grammar: concession with a pesar de que and pese a

items: I can say why justice was still a problem after the dictatorships.
I can explain what the Colombian tutela allowed people to do.
I can say what happened to the commanders of the juntas in Argentina in 1985.
I can admit a difficulty and go on with *a pesar de*, *a pesar de que* and *pese a*.
